snippets.description: Calculates the Nth Fibonacci number by calling itself again and again until it reaches the base case.
Sorts an array by picking a pivot, splitting items into smaller and bigger groups, then sorting each group the same way.
Creates a building block for a linked list. Each node holds a value and a pointer to the next node.
Waits until the user stops doing something (like typing) for a set time before actually running the function.
Fetches data from a URL, waits for the response, converts it to JSON, and handles any errors that happen.
Checks if a word or sentence reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring spaces and punctuation.
Creates an endless counter that gives you the next number each time you ask for it, starting from 0.
Combines two arrays into one, removes duplicates, and sorts the result from smallest to largest.
Quickly finds an item in a sorted list by checking the middle and cutting the search area in half each time.
Limits how often a function can run. Even if called many times, it only runs once per time window.
Takes a nested array (arrays inside arrays) and flattens everything into one single-level array.
A simple event system where you can listen for named events and trigger them later with data.
